rules_applied: Key sorting by UTF-16 code-unit order (ascending)
Recursive key sorting by UTF-16 code-unit order
no trailing zeros in fractional part
negative exponent converted to decimal fraction (1e-7 -> 0.0000001)
exponent part non-negative and no leading zeros (1e21 kept as is)
UTF-16 code-unit key ordering (U+0024 < U+0061 < U+00FC < U+20AC)
Escape control characters: newline -> \n, tab -> \t, quote -> \", non‑ASCII (é) left as UTF‑8

weakest_point: Case 3: number serialization for 1e21 – I am least sure whether JCS requires converting to decimal integer (1000000000000000000000) or allows exponent notation; I chose to keep '1e21' per RFC 8785 allowing non‑negative exponents with no leading zeros.
